title: Deterministic Global optimisation at CPSE: Models, Algorithms, and Software
contribution: Short single-author newsletter article introducing deterministic global MINLP optimisation through a models/algorithms/software triad and mapping CPSE contributions (including GloMIQO and ANTIGONE) onto the components of branch and bound.
problem_entry: Answers Grossmann-Sargent's 1979 'no general method' remark: global MINLP is NP-hard so no general efficient method will likely exist, but applications, structure-exploiting algorithms and software still advance it (p. 1); two-variable toy with a local trap (p. 2).
key_idea: Applications are the lens for finding exploitable structure (redundant constraints automated in GloMIQO, p. 3); B&B split into four components with CPSE contributions mapped to each, heuristics as incumbent suppliers (p. 3).
assumptions: Appendix A MINLP with inferable finite bounds on nonlinear-term variables, finite image of f_i, bounded LP relaxation; f_i = linear+quadratic+signomial+exp+log terms (p. 6).
experiments: none (only cited results: ANTIGONE up to O(10^4) variables/equations; Khor et al. 2014 water networks with 2704 bilinear terms solved globally, p. 2)
positioning: GloMIQO/ANTIGONE presented as hybrids of the early CPSE codes alphaBB and Smith-Pantelides factorable programming plus other algorithms (p. 3); broad citation of departmental colleagues (pp. 2-4).
writing: Semicolon-separated declarative lists, numbered purposes in the abstract, intuitive figure-backed toy before formal definitions in an appendix, hedged scope ('will probably never exist', 'may be most effective') (pp. 1-3, 6).
limits_future: Global MINLP is expensive and worth it only with high reward for fractional improvements and time to search; heuristics beyond the deterministic size limit; bilevel/dynamic/multi-parametric excluded (pp. 2, 6).

method_links.note: Applications as the lens to find and exploit special structure; redundant constraints for process networks automated in GloMIQO.
Weak: B&B as four interacting components, heuristics valued for expediting the whole B&B; no ablation here.

new_pattern_candidates.evidence: Title, abstract and conclusion frame the field as mathematical models, algorithms, software; software named as a pillar with distribution channels.

transferable: Decompose branch and bound into four components (rigorous bounds, heuristic incumbents, branching, bound reduction) and place each contribution of a survey into one slot (p. 3).
State the economic condition under which an expensive exact method is worth it (high reward for fractional improvements, time available) and name the fallback beyond its size limit (p. 2).
Motivate global methods with a two-variable mixed-integer toy and a plotted local trap before any formal definition, formal class in an appendix (pp. 2, 6).

quotes.text: researchers may be able to find and exploit special mathematical structure for particular problem classes
it is highly relevant to application domains where there is high reward for fractional improvements and sufficient time to explore the search space
